params.heat: 0..1 the heat sink fins glow red and warm beads start to ride the first channel
params.flow: phase, any number: beads ride the channels (warm out to the tower, cool back); +1 is one full lap of one bead slot
params.evap: 0..1 vapour puffs rise out of the fan stack; cool beads return; the basin water dims
params.rise: phase, any number: how far the puffs have travelled (use with evap)
params.fan: phase, any number: the fan blades turn one turn per unit
params.drops: 0..5 the lamps on the rail light one by one (drops of water)
params.power: 0..1 the dial needle sweeps (electricity the cooling takes); rest 0.18
